神剑仙猿穆人清.zh-CN: 托特与伊姆霍特普正在比较各自的教学方法。

神剑仙猿穆人清。.en: Thoth and Imhotep are comparing teaching methods.
神剑仙猿穆人清。.zh-CN: 托特与伊姆霍特普正在比较各自的教学方法。

铁剑门掌门木桑道长.en: Imhotep is enjoying a game with Thoth.
铁剑门掌门木桑道长.zh-CN: 伊姆霍特普正与托特对弈。

袁承志得到穆人清和木桑道长真传。.en: Horus trained with Thoth and Imhotep.
袁承志得到穆人清和木桑道长真传。.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯向托特与伊姆霍特普学习。

木桑道人穆人清考校袁承志。.en: Thoth and Imhotep tested Horus and offered another lesson.
木桑道人穆人清考校袁承志。.zh-CN: 托特与伊姆霍特普考察荷鲁斯，并再次指点了他。

description.zh-CN: 通过托特与伊姆霍特普的考验。

description.en: Studied with Thoth and Imhotep after their trial.
description.zh-CN: 在考验后向托特与伊姆霍特普学习。

text.en: Your king has nowhere to go, Thoth. Even wisdom needs an exit.
text.zh-CN: 你的国王无路可走了，托特。就算是智慧，也得有条退路。

text.en: My king was doing well until your hand passed over the board.
text.zh-CN: 你的手掠过棋盘之前，我的国王还好好的。

text.en: A bold accusation. I'm fast, not dishonest.
text.zh-CN: 这指控可真大胆。我手快，可不代表我作弊。

text.en: Still arguing over the same game?
text.zh-CN: 还在为同一盘棋争论？

text.en: Perfect timing. You can lose the next game instead.
text.zh-CN: 来得正好。下一盘，换你来输。

text.en: Horus, good to see you. Isis, has he been keeping out of trouble?
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，见到你真好。伊西斯，他最近有没有少惹些麻烦？

text.en: About as well as you two keep quiet.
text.zh-CN: 和你们两个保持安静的本事，差不多吧。

text.en: We were discussing which of us taught him better.
text.zh-CN: 我们正在讨论，到底是谁把他教得更好。

text.en: An awkward question, since I improved everything you taught him.
text.zh-CN: 这问题不太公平。毕竟，你教他的那些，我都替他改进过了。

text.en: Then stop asking the board. Let Horus face you both.
text.zh-CN: 那就别问棋盘了。让荷鲁斯来面对你们两个。

text.en: Finally. A game I can play standing up.
text.zh-CN: 总算能来一场，站着进行的较量了。

text.en: Well. That settles absolutely nothing.
text.zh-CN: 好吧。看来，什么也没争出结果。

text.en: It settles that Horus can manage both of us.
text.zh-CN: 至少争明白了一件事：荷鲁斯能应付我们两个。

text.en: Which was my teaching, clearly.
text.zh-CN: 这显然，是我教得好。

text.en: I'm beginning to see why you prefer a board.
text.zh-CN: 我开始明白，你们为什么更喜欢对着棋盘争论了。

text.en: Never mind the score. Watch this next movement.
text.zh-CN: 先别管谁赢几局。看好接下来这一式。

text.en: Then take my Fleetfoot Training Notes, and watch how Arcane Rain spreads.
text.zh-CN: 那也收下我的疾步训练笔记，再看看奥术之雨是怎样展开的。

text.en: Enough lessons. Thoth, bring the board. We can argue somewhere with a better view.
text.zh-CN: 课先上到这里。托特，带上棋盘。咱们换个风景好的地方继续争。

text.en: Keep practicing, Horus. Isis, try to keep him out of too much trouble.
text.zh-CN: 继续练习，荷鲁斯。伊西斯，尽量让他少惹些麻烦。

text.en: Now that was a proper workout.
text.zh-CN: 这才算，真正活动了一回筋骨。

text.en: Horus, you've learned to make us work for it.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，你已经学会让我们认真出手了。

text.en: That's what I call a useful student.
text.zh-CN: 这样的学生，教起来才有意思。

text.en: I was hoping for a less painful recommendation.
text.zh-CN: 我还希望，能得到一份没这么疼的评价。

text.en: A lesson, then. Watch Arcane Rain, and look for the openings between the strikes.
text.zh-CN: 那就再学一课。看清奥术之雨，也留意每次攻击之间的空当。

text.en: Thoth, bring the board. I still owe you a game.
text.zh-CN: 托特，带上棋盘。我还欠你一局。

text.en: You owe me an explanation for the last one. Take care, both of you.
text.zh-CN: 上一局的事，你还欠我个解释呢。你们两个，路上保重。

text.en: Well. That settles absolutely nothing.
text.zh-CN: 好吧。看来，什么也没争出结果。

text.en: It settles that Horus can manage both of us.
text.zh-CN: 至少争明白了一件事：荷鲁斯能应付我们两个。

text.en: A fine advertisement for my lessons.
text.zh-CN: 这可给我的教学，做了个好榜样。

text.en: Both of your lessons.
text.zh-CN: 是你们两位的教学。

text.en: Diplomatic. Now watch this movement.
text.zh-CN: 很会说话。现在，看清这一式。

text.en: And now for Arcane Rain. A different way to keep an opponent guessing.
text.zh-CN: 接下来是奥术之雨。换一种方法，让对手猜不透你的下一步。

text.en: Is that all? He's finally standing still long enough to listen.
text.zh-CN: 这就结束了？难得他能站稳一会儿，认真听你们说话。

text.en: One lesson at a time. Let him use this one before you ask for another.
text.zh-CN: 一课一课来。先让他把这一课用好，再学下一课。

text.en: Come on, Thoth. Bring the board; the view is better outside.
text.zh-CN: 走吧，托特。带上棋盘，外面的风景更好。

text.en: Keep practicing, Horus. Put it to good use.
text.zh-CN: 继续练习，荷鲁斯。把学到的本领用好。

text.en: Now that was a proper workout.
text.zh-CN: 这才算，真正活动了一回筋骨。

text.en: You held your ground, Horus. Keep working on the timing.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯，你站稳了脚跟。出手的时机，还要继续琢磨。

text.en: And don't let him convince you this was all his idea.
text.zh-CN: 还有，别让他把主意全算到自己头上。

text.en: I'd settle for convincing him to stop hitting me.
text.zh-CN: 能先劝他别再打我，我就满意了。

text.en: Watch Arcane Rain. A change of approach can be useful.
text.zh-CN: 看看奥术之雨。换一种思路，有时很管用。

text.en: Perhaps a little more advice before you go?
text.zh-CN: 走之前，是不是还能再指点几句？

text.en: Let him try this first. Advice is easier to collect than practice.
text.zh-CN: 先让他试试这些吧。收集建议，可比真正练习容易多了。

text.en: Speaking of practice, Thoth, you still owe me a game.
text.zh-CN: 说到练习，托特，你还欠我一盘棋。

text.en: Then let's find a board you haven't touched. Take care, both of you.
text.zh-CN: 那就先找一副，你还没碰过的棋盘吧。你们两个，路上保重。
